U_b(f,x,y)=[z²f+azx+q_b y]/q_b maps H²⊕C² bijectively with equivalent H² norms and transports M_z to [S, v_b;0,A], with v_b(x,y)=e0(ax+by), A(x,y)=(ay,0). Since S*e0=0, defect D_b=[[a²-1,ab],[ab,a²+b²-1]], det=(a²-1)²-b²>0: expansion rank exactly 2. Log-concavity slack E=D+D²-A*DA has det=-a^6 b² and at b=0 is positive diagonal, giving iff b=0. CNP normalized kernel 1+R/(q q*) has F=1-1/K, and congruent Q=q q* F has coefficient block degrees (2,3) [[0,b/a²],[b/a²,1-a^-2-b²/a^4]] of determinant -b²/a^4; negative determinant for b≠0 contradicts positive analytically coefficient kernel. For b=0, 1-1/K=sum_{n>=1} f_n (z wbar)^n has f1=a^-2>0,f2=0,f_n=alpha f_{n-1}+beta f_{n-2}>=0, with alpha=1-a^-2, beta=(a²-1)/a^4, so the standard normalized CNP criterion applies. The b=0 ordinary concavity slack is indefinite. The rank-one operator difference is exactly |b|. Independently confirmed symbolic determinant identities for D and E and inspected exact formal-bivariate verifier. No all-rank-two-shift or nonreal b generalization is claimed.
